description: Search Revamp Vacations' published listings in Armenia: places to stay, tours, experiences, restaurants (eat) and places to visit. Returns each match's slug, type, location, headline price in AMD, short description, page link, and the listing's own cover photo (image) — use that photo when showing the result. When the user gives dates, pass startDate (and endDate for stays) and guests: the search then returns only listings that are actually free for those dates, each with its exact all-in total (fees and tax included), cheapest first. For one listing's full price breakdown and terms, use get_quote.

cuisine.description: For restaurants: a cuisine/venue type, e.g. 'Armenian', 'Fast food'.

query.description: Free-text match on title, description, tags, cuisine, city.

startDate.description: Optional. Check-in date for stays, or the activity date, YYYY-MM-DD — returns only listings free then, with totals.

name: search_listings
title: Search Revamp listings
